input_records.statement: In the Tate category generated by h(P¹)=1⊕Q(-1), tensor automorphisms fix the unit inclusion, whereas nonzero Lefschetz raising does not. Therefore its sl₂ action is not automatically a subgroup action of that motivic Galois group.

On H*(X) for a smooth projective d-fold, with degree cocharacter w acting by t^r on H^r and Lefschetz h acting by r−d, dw=h+d·id. The corresponding group equation is ρ(w(t))=t^d λ_sl2(t) on this chosen realization.
For a morphism L:h^i(X)→h^(i+2)(X)(1), naturality gives g_(i+2)Lg_i^(-1)=χ(g)^(-1)L after trivializing the Tate line; it commutes with kerχ.

Tensor naturality for L:h^r(X)⊗L→h^(r+2)(X) gives g Lg−1=χ_L(g)L; ker χ_L commutes with normalized Lefschetz sl2. The Tate category generated by h(P1)=1⊕L has group G_m, precluding an sl2 subgroup inducing its nonzero Lefschetz action.
A tensor weight cocharacter and the variety-dependent shifted Lefschetz Cartan grading are different structures; the latter acts on H⁰(P¹) with nonzero shifted weight.

On h(P¹)=1⊕L, tensor automorphisms act diag(1,t), whereas the prescribed Lefschetz raising matrix sends the unit class to the point class. Therefore that specific sl₂ action is not induced by a motivic tensor subgroup. Its Cartan τ(s)=diag(s^{-1},s) and weight j(s)=diag(1,s²) satisfy j=s·id·τ; conjugation scales raising/lowering by the Tate character and its inverse.
The earlier run separates the Lefschetz sl₂ action on h(P¹)=1⊕L from tensor automorphisms fixing the unit, and separates diag(1,s²) from diag(s^−1,s) by a scalar factor.
